SELECT
  COALESCE(ir.caption, tv.title) AS title,
  COALESCE(ir.author, tv.author) AS author,
  COALESCE(CAST(ir.views AS TEXT), tv.views) AS views,
  COALESCE(CAST(ir.likes AS TEXT), tv.likes) AS likes,
  COALESCE(ir.hashtags, tv.hashtags::text) AS hashtags,
  COALESCE(ir.niche, tv.category) AS category
FROM (SELECT '{{ $json.selected_video_id || $json.selectedVideoId }}' AS vid) q
LEFT JOIN instagram_reels ir ON ir.reel_id = q.vid
LEFT JOIN trending_videos tv ON tv.video_id = q.vid
LIMIT 1;

parameters.text:
+ $json.userPrompt : '' }}

Your job: write an ORIGINAL 15-30 second Instagram Reel script that is INSPIRED by the above post. Borrow its energy, hook style, and what made it go viral. Make it fresh and engaging.

Provide your response as a JSON object with these fields:
- hook: A punchy opening line (2 seconds)
- middle: The main body of the script
- cta: A strong call-to-action
- visual_directions: Brief visual direction notes
- music_vibe: Suggested music mood
- hashtags: Array of 5-8 relevant hashtags (include #)
- full_script: The complete spoken script. IMPORTANT: Inside this field, format the text using exactly these 3 section labels on their own lines: [HOOK], [SUBJECT], and [CONCLUSION].

Output ONLY valid JSON. No markdown, no explanation.
